blurb: Porter's Landing Boat Takeout is a location where paddlers can take out their boats after a scenic 3-mile paddle on the Jordan River from Riverview Boat Ramp in Salt Lake City to Porter's Landing in North Salt Lake. The site is associated with the City of North Salt Lake and is mentioned in the context of the annual Jordan River Paddle event.
